title.narrative: Workplace compliance through social dialogue and labour inspection promoted and facilitated

description.narrative: A multidimensional approach will be adopted to enhance governance in occupational safety and health through the adoption of policies, programs, or the strengthening of existing institutions. The pilots of Strategic compliance plans in select sectors will be scaled in other parts of the economy. The establishment of national recording and notification systems on OSH will be a critical component of the strategy, allowing for regular reporting against SDG indicator 8.8.1. Furthermore, evidence-based wage policies or measures, including adequate statutory or negotiated minimum wages, will be developed to address issues of low pay, working poverty, wage inequality and gender pay gaps and improve the overall well-being of workers. This will involve conducting thorough research, knowledge building and assessment and technical advisory services and capacity building of constituents to ensure wage adequacy and improvement of wage-setting systems supported through social dialogue, including in the area of minimum wages, statutory or negotiated and tackling pay discrimination (particularly based on gender and migrant status). The Government of Pakistan's prioritization of labor dispute resolution is crucial for fostering a fair and stable work environment. Building on the International Labour Organization's assessment tools demonstrates a commitment to utilizing internationally recognized standards for evaluating the effectiveness of LDR institutions and mechanisms. Social dialogue both through tripartite consultation and bipartite arrangement will be integral, strengthening capacities of the government and social partners in this respect will be important. The support will be extended in ensuring that the tripartite and bipartite mechanisms remain effective and are optimally utilised for discourse. The National Coalition on Social Justice will be leveraged to promote social dialogue and industrial harmony.
